verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents a scriptable gcloud CLI that manages authentication, configuration and API interactions, plus REST APIs and client libraries explicitly pitched for automating workflows. It also supports declarative Terraform deployments with previews, and Workload Identity Federation lets external workloads authenticate without service-account keys, which together cover the core of headless/CI automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (non-interactive/headless flags, CI provider integrations), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
